notes: This is a test variant of the MakerDAO Flapper (kick sets end = 0 and its vat.move is commented out; deal no longer requires tic != 0; cage and deal skip the vat) and the text matches it exactly: wards/live checks, kicks++ with the uint(-1) bound, the packed Bid struct (guy, tic = field_672, end = field_720 in slot +2), tick's uint48 add check and packed write of end (whole-slot arithmetic, P15), tend's bid checks and two gem.move calls, deal's gem.burn and delete, yank, file with its three keys, and the anonymous LibNote events (log call.func_hash with caller, arg1, cd[36] topics). No loops.
